_source: Option lists configured on the Config page (Status, Classification -> Category, Products, Priority SLA). 'Unassigned' is the status every newly ingested email ticket starts in. Each status's 'clock' is what the resolution clock does in it: NOT_STARTED (work not begun), RUNNING (our side working), PAUSED (waiting on the bank), STOPPED (resolved/closed). The SLA due date never pauses.
_teamTypes: Kinds of team (HD_DEPARTMENT_MASTER.Team_Type), managed on the Config page. Support teams own banks; other teams (e.g. Product: Java, Angular) are pulled in on a ticket by cross-team assignment. More types can be added.
_escalationLevels: Escalation matrix: per priority, level N is reached offsetHours from the SLA due date (negative = before due, 0 = at due, positive = after), counted on the bank's SLA working-day calendar. Resolved/closed tickets never escalate.
